findings.key_quote: Graphics revenue – The year-over-year increase in the second quarter and first half of fiscal year 2027 was driven by sales of our Blackwell architecture.
findings.justification: E5 explicitly states that Graphics revenue (which includes Gaming per the segment definition) increased year-over-year in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 (the three months ended July 26, 2026) and that this increase was driven by sales of Blackwell architecture. The period_status is UNKNOWN because the passage covers multiple periods, but the key_quote specifically identifies 'second quarter' which matches the claim period. The evidence directly establishes both the growth and its cause (Blackwell architecture sales, which includes GeForce GPUs per the product descriptions in other evidence).
